remarks: For quick occupancy for this month!! Price reduce.  Enjoy easy, low-maintenance living in this spacious 2-bedroom condo at Fountain Terrace, a gated community in the heart of Stamford. Residents enjoy elevator access, a seasonal pool, fitness center, community room, card-operated laundry, and gated security. Conveniently located just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro-North, restaurants, shopping, parks, and I-95. A great opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and excellent amenities. Currently tenant occupied; One month rent and 2 month security. Easy to show .
